intro_en: You will learn to say the same thing to a friend, a grandmother, a boss and a stranger by changing чи/та, request endings and verb forms. You will also practice English softeners and levels of politeness.
intro_mn: Та чи/та, хүсэлтийн нөхцөл, үйл үгийн хэлбэрийг сольж найз, эмээ, дарга, танихгүй хүнд нэг зүйлийг өөр өөрөөр хэлж сурна. Мөн англи хэлний зөөлрүүлэгч үг, эелдэг байдлын түвшнийг дадлагажуулна.

vocab.example_en: I changed my style of speaking.
She is a very polite person.
We interact politely with our bosses.
You should show respect to elders.

vocab.example_mn: Чи ёстой шууд хүн юм аа.
vocab.example_en: You are really a blunt person.
Talking to your boss like this is inappropriate.

sentences.en: To a friend you say, "Just close the window."
alt_en: You tell a friend, "Go close the window."

sentences.en: You politely say to your grandmother, "Please close the window."
alt_en: To your grandmother you politely say, "Please close the window."

sentences.en: You ask your boss, "Could you close the window?"
alt_en: You ask your boss, "Would you close the window?"

sentences.mn: Танихгүй хүнд "Уучлаарай, цонхыг хаах уу?" гэнэ.
sentences.en: To a stranger you say, "Excuse me, shall I close the window?"
alt_en: You say to a stranger, "Excuse me, should I close the window?"
sentences.mn_latin: Tanikhgüi khünd "Uuchlaarai, tsonkhyg khaakh uu?" gene.

sentences.mn: Би чамд хэлэх гэсэн юм, чи үүнийг ийм шууд хэлэхгүй байж болохгүй юу?
sentences.en: I wanted to tell you: couldn't you avoid saying it so bluntly?
sentences.mn_latin: Bi chamd khelekh gesen yum, chi üüniig iim shuud khelekhgüi baij bolokhgüi yuu?

sentences.en: Saying "чи" to your teacher is not appropriate.
alt_en: It is not appropriate to say "чи" to your teacher.

sentences.mn: Би дарга нартай албан ёсны хэв маягаар ярьдаг.
sentences.en: I speak with my bosses in a formal style.
alt_en: I talk to my bosses in a formal register.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi darga nartai alban yosny khev mayagaar yaridag.

sentences.mn: Түүний хүсэлт эелдэг боловч маш шууд байсан.
sentences.en: His request was polite but very direct.
alt_en: His request was polite, but very blunt.
sentences.mn_latin: Tüünii khüselt eyeldeg bolovch mash shuud baisan.

sentences.en: When we talk with friends, we do not soften our language.
alt_en: We don't soften our language when we talk with friends.

sentences.mn: Настай хүнд хүндэтгэл үзүүлж, "та" гэж хэлдэг.
sentences.en: We show respect to elders and say "та" to them.
alt_en: You show respect to an older person and address them as "та".
sentences.mn_latin: Nastai khünd khündetgel üzüülj, "ta" gej kheldeg.

sentences.mn: Би чамаас жаахан тусламж гуйхыг хүсэж байна.
sentences.en: I'd like to ask you for a little help.
alt_en: I was hoping to ask you for a bit of help.
sentences.mn_latin: Bi chamaas jaakhan tuslamj guikhyg khüsej baina.

sentences.mn: Тэр "тэгэх байх" гэж хэлээд үгээ зөөлрүүлсэн.
sentences.en: He said "I guess so" and softened his words.
alt_en: He softened his words by saying "probably."
sentences.mn_latin: Ter "tegekh baikh" gej kheleed ügee zöölrüülsen.

grammar.title_en: Choosing the level: чи/та and request endings
grammar.title_mn: Түвшин сонгох: чи/та ба хүсэлтийн нөхцөл
grammar.explain_en: Mongolian marks politeness through pronouns and verb endings. Friends and younger people get чи with a bare command (хаа!) or a casual ending like -чих (хаачих, just do it). Elders and strangers get та with -аарай/-ээрэй (хаагаарай, a gentle request). With bosses, a question such as -хгүй юу? (Хаахгүй юу?) sounds softest. Words like уучлаарай (excuse me) and болж өгвөл (if possible) add further politeness.
grammar.explain_mn: Монгол хэлэнд эелдэг байдлыг чи/та төлөөний үг болон үйлийн нөхцлөөр илэрхийлдэг. Найз, өөрөөсөө залууд "чи" гэж хэлээд тушаах хэлбэр (хаа!) эсвэл -чих (хаачих) нөхцөл хэрэглэнэ. Настай хүн, танихгүй хүнд "та" гэж хэлээд -аарай/-ээрэй (хаагаарай) хэрэглэнэ. Даргад "Хаахгүй юу?" гэх мэт асуултын хэлбэр хамгийн зөөлөн сонсогдоно. "Уучлаарай", "болж өгвөл" зэрэг үг эелдэг байдлыг нэмэгдүүлнэ.

examples.en: Close the window. (blunt, to a close friend)
Would you mind closing the window? (softest)

fill_blank.translation: To grandma: "Grandma, please sit down and have tea!"
fill_blank.explain_en: Grandmothers get the polite request ending -аарай, not a bare command.

fill_blank.text: Дарга аа, энэ тайланг нэг харж ___?
fill_blank.translation: Boss, could you take a look at this report?
fill_blank.explain_en: A question with үү/уу? is a soft, respectful request to a boss.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Даргад үү/уу? гэсэн асуултын хэлбэр зөөлөн хүсэлт болно.

fill_blank.translation: To a friend: "Come here and help me."
fill_blank.explain_en: With a close friend a bare imperative like ир is natural.
fill_blank.explain_mn: Дотны найзад "ир" гэсэн энгийн тушаах хэлбэр хэвийн.

fill_blank.text: Excuse me, ___ you tell me where the bank is?
fill_blank.translation: Уучлаарай, банк хаана байдгийг хэлж өгөхгүй юу?
fill_blank.explain_en: Could is the polite choice for a stranger.

fill_blank.text: I'm ___ tired, so I might skip the party.
fill_blank.translation: Би жаахан ядарсан болохоор үдэшлэгийг алгасаж магадгүй.
fill_blank.explain_en: "Kind of" is a hedge that softens a statement.

options: I was wondering if you could give
fill_blank.explain_en: Gimme is very casual, fine only with close friends.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Сарнай, чи энэ тайланг маргааш гэхэд хийчих үү?
dialogue.en: Sarnai, can you get this report done by tomorrow?
dialogue.mn_latin: Sarnai, chi ene tailang margaash gekhed khiichikh üü?

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.mn: Болд оо, би жаахан завгүй байна, чадах эсэхээ мэдэхгүй байна.
dialogue.en: Bold, I'm kind of busy, so I'm not sure I can.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bold oo, bi jaakhan zavgüi baina, chadakh esekhee medekhgüi baina.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Ойлголоо. Тэгвэл даргаас хэр хугацаа өгч болохыг асууя.
dialogue.en: I see. Then I'll ask the boss how much time he can give.
dialogue.mn_latin: Oilgoloo. Tegvel dargaas kher khugatsaa ögch bolokhyg asuuya.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: Дарга аа, уучлаарай, тайланг баасан гаригт өгч болох уу?
dialogue.en: Boss, excuse me, would it be possible to hand in the report on Friday?
dialogue.mn_latin: Darga aa, uuchlaarai, tailang baasan garigt ögch bolokh uu?

dialogue.speaker: Дарга
dialogue.mn: Болно, гэхдээ ямар нэг саатал гарвал надад заавал хэлээрэй.
dialogue.en: Yes, but please be sure to tell me if there is any delay.
dialogue.mn_latin: Bolno, gekhdee yamar neg saatal garval nadad zaaval kheleerei.

dialogue.speaker: Болд
dialogue.mn: За, баярлалаа. Сарнай, баасан гараг хүртэл хугацаа авлаа шүү.
dialogue.en: Okay, thank you. Sarnai, I got until Friday.
dialogue.mn_latin: Za, bayarlalaa. Sarnai, baasan garag khürtel khugatsaa avlaa shüü.

dialogue.speaker: Сарнай
dialogue.en: Great! I guess I can make it.

culture_note.en: In Mongolian, age and status matter a great deal, so switching between чи and та, and between plain and polite endings, is a sign of social skill. Using чи with an elder or a boss can sound rude, while using та with a close friend can sound cold or sarcastic. English relies more on tone and softeners such as "could," "just," and "I guess."
culture_note.mn: Монгол хэлэнд нас, албан тушаал чухал учир чи, та хоёрыг зөв сонгож, энгийн болон эелдэг нөхцлийг сольж хэрэглэх нь нийгмийн ур чадвар гэж үзэгддэг. Настай хүн, даргад "чи" гэвэл бүдүүлэг сонсогдож, дотны найзад "та" гэвэл хол, эсвэл тохуутай сонсогдож болно. Англи хэлэнд "could", "just", "I guess" зэрэг үг, өнгө аясаар эелдэг байдлыг илэрхийлдэг.

review.notes: Generally useful lesson, but with a wrong case form, mismatched explain_mn, a broken fill-in item, and a few inaccurate translations.

opus_fix.notes: Main problems: wrong word choices (хэв шинж, тааруухан, заавал), spelling errors (эелдгээр, туслаач, хүсэж), case government, and an ambiguous fill-in-the-blank.

changes.why: mn omitted чи/та, endings and verb forms; 'хүн дөрөвт' was awkward
хэв шинж means 'characteristic/type', not speaking style or register
the correct form is эелдгээр (vowel dropped)
тааруухан is the wrong word here
заавал means 'definitely', not a politeness marker
тусаач is misspelled; it should be туслаач
ирээрэй is also acceptable with a friend, so the blank had two correct answers
'хэлж өгч чадах уу' is an unnatural calque
'by tomorrow' is маргааш гэхэд, not хүртэл
the original was ungrammatical and awkward
амжих = 'make it in time'; Сайн байна is odd here
Ах хүн means an older man, not 'an elder'
